prompt: Build a 3-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 3 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = sum over weighted edges of w_ij * Z_i * Z_j. Graph: edge (0,1) weight 0.6, edge (1,2) weight -0.4, edge (0,2) weight 0.9. gamma = 0.5. Any correct implementation of the phase term is accepted (Z_i*Z_j is diagonal, so any gate sequence producing the same phase per computational basis state is correct — it does not need to match one specific decomposition). No measurement.
